text:
Priya: quick async — final readiness check for mpt-25b-v2 onboarding. Need short signoff on weights location, tokenizer quirks, calibration data, and quant path (AWQ/GPTQ/FP8). Ticket AI-4521: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/AI-4521

Priya: weights are at s3://redwood-models/mpt-25b/v2/weights.tar.lz4 and there is a manifest at s3://redwood-models/mpt-25b/v2/manifest.json (sharded parts: 0000..0007). Tokenizer at s3://redwood-models/mpt-25b/v2/tokenizer.json. Calibration set for initial checks: s3://redwood-calib/mpt-25b/v1/calib.jsonl

Sam: quick Q — manifest has `shard_count: 8`? just want to ensure serve infra picks up the parts. also: are we keeping the old special token mapping?

Priya: yes shard_count: 8 in the manifest. we kept legacy special tokens (```{ "<s>": 0, "</s>": 1, "<|pad|>": 2 }```) but note tokenizer uses the old byte-level spacing behavior — see below.

Priya: proposed serve config (short):
```
serve:
  model_name: mpt-25b-v2
  weights: s3://redwood-models/mpt-25b/v2/weights.tar.lz4
  quant: awq
  awq:
    bits: 4
    block_size: 128
  tokenizer:
    path: s3://redwood-models/mpt-25b/v2/tokenizer.json
    add_prefix_space: true
```

Mel: heads-up on tokenizer quirks — during evaluation we saw leading-space sensitivity on code-like prompts. without `add_prefix_space` some completions drop the first token. small reproducible example: input `" def foo():` tokenizes differently depending on leading space. set `add_prefix_space: true` for consistency.

Nina: calibration runs summary (short): AWQ4 vs fp16 on our 2k-dev set: MMLU -1.4% absolute, Lambada perplexity +3.2%. GPTQ6 showed -0.9% MMLU. FP8 (experimental) not run at scale yet; dynamic-range failure on ~12 inputs (outliers). full logs: s3://redwood-calib/mpt-25b/v1/logs/2026-03-12-run.tar.gz

Jon: policy check — our internal threshold for auto-approve is <=2% MMLU drop for latency-first workloads. AWQ4 is within that bound on the dev set. LGTM from my side for AWQ4 canary.

Sam: noted. I'll run a quick tokenizer smoke: reproduce the leading-space case + check BOS/EOS mapping. expect to finish in ~30m.

Mel: one caveat — FP8 could give better latency/cost but riskier on those outliers. recommend FP8 as follow-up experimental track, not primary rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: mpt-25b-v2 (awq4) — 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z — region: us-west-2 — initial traffic: 10% — fallback: mpt-25b-v2-fp16

Priya: sounds good. plan: lock AWQ4 for hosted canary, run tokenizer smoke (Sam), ops to watch dev metrics and failover to fp16 if MMLU drop >2.5% in canary. will create small rollback playbook in the ticket.

Sam: smoke passed locally — tokenizer mapping looks OK after `add_prefix_space: true`. pushed a tiny patch to the serving config in the ticket (commented).

Nina: adding calibration artifact note — we should persist per-shard calibration tables for AWQ so we can repro. created s3://redwood-calib/mpt-25b/v1/awq_tables/part-*.pt

Jon: LGTM. if no objections by EOD PST we proceed with canary. @Mel please flag if you want FP8 gated.

Mel: agree — gate FP8. AWQ4 canary is fine. :thumbsup:

Priya: thanks all — locking this. if anything unexpected during canary ping #eng-oncall and mention me.

Sam: noted. closing my smoke then. :white_check_mark:

Priya: (final) quick checklist summary added to ticket AI-4521: weights path ok, tokenizer add_prefix_space true, calibration set linked, AWQ4 approved for canary, FP8 experimental/gated.
